title: WitnessPayloadV3
description: The JSON a trooth.witness-statement.v3 payload holds: the v2 content plus subject_id and signer, serialized as RFC 8785 (JCS). Every number is an integer between -(2^53 - 1) and 2^53 - 1, so every implementation produces the same bytes.

counts.description: Counts that must agree with the checks.

domain.description: The domain the reading was taken of: lowercase, no trailing dot.

evaluator.description: The software that took the reading.

evidence_manifest.description: The evidence manifest, bound by digest.

methodology.description: The check mapping, bound by digest.

read_at.description: When Trooth took the reading, as Trooth asserts it when signing. There is no independent timestamp. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

reading_id.description: The id of the reading. Also usable as trooth:reading:<reading_id> (docs/IDS.md).

signer.description: The signing key, inside the signed bytes.

subject_id.description: The subject by its stable id, trooth:domain:<domain> (docs/IDS.md). MUST name the payload domain.

Signer.title: Signer
Signer.description: The signing key, named inside the signed bytes so the envelope cannot point at another key.

key_id.description: The kid of the signing key. MUST equal the envelope key_id.
